children.name: Article Lead
children.text: Combine local accounts, service accounts, OIDC providers, custom roles, ownership, and per-server collaboration without creating a lockout path.

children.name: Article Callout Text
children.text: Keep one tested administrative recovery path until OIDC and role mappings are verified end to end.

children.name: Section Body 1
children.text: Invite and edit local users, reset credentials deliberately, and give automation its own account rather than a shared login.

children.name: Section 1 Item Text 0
children.text: Require strong passwords and remove dormant local accounts.

children.name: Section 1 Item Text 1
children.text: Give each automation its own local user with the minimum role, and rotate its password.

children.name: Section 1 Item Text 2
children.text: Audit invites, resets, disabled accounts, and ownership transfers.

children.name: Section Body 2
children.text: Built-in and custom roles group explicit permissions for servers, backups, templates, users, and platform operations.

children.name: Section 2 Item Text 0
children.text: Start with read-only and add mutation permissions by workflow.

children.name: Section 2 Item Text 1
children.text: Separate global administration from per-server collaboration. Only * holders grant admin-level permissions.

children.name: Section 2 Item Text 2
children.text: Review custom roles after new features introduce additional permissions.

children.name: Section Body 3
children.text: Configure identity providers through Helm and validate claims, redirects, role mapping, and SSO-only behavior.

children.name: Quick Reference Line 1
children.text: 01  Keep a local admin session open while testing the identity provider

children.name: Quick Reference Line 2
children.text: 02  Verify redirect URI, issuer, claims, groups, and mapped permissions

children.name: Quick Reference Line 3
children.text: 03  Test login and logout in a private session before enforcing SSO-only
